channel.title: Business Today India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Today India (businesstoday.in)

item.title: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 4.6 with performance upgrades and coding accuracy
item.description: Anthropic's next-generation coding AI model, the Claude Opus 4.6, is here with upgraded performance and accuracy.

item.title: Will Union Budget 2026’s cancer drug duty cuts actually lower treatment costs?
item.description: Study notes lowering taxes on finished cancer drug formulations does not automatically lead to price reductions for patients.

item.title: Suzlon Energy shares: Motilal Oswal sees 55% upside; ICICI flags execution bottlenecks
item.description: Domestic brokerage firms continue to remain largely positive on Suzlon Energy with select analysts expecting the stock to rise more than 55 per cent from its current levels.

item.title: Anthropic and OpenAI push ‘Agentic’ AI into the workplace, forcing enterprises to rethink how work gets done
item.description: The push comes as enterprises worldwide rethink how software is built and how office tasks are performed, with developers increasingly acting as supervisors to multiple AI workers rather than writing every line of code themselves.

item.title: All India Breakdown: Why are Ola, Uber, Rapido drivers going on strike, list of demands, the Nitin Gadkari connection and more
item.description: Cab drivers strike on February 7: The nationwide protest has been dubbed as the "All India Breakdown" and drivers are likely to switch off their ride-hailing apps simultaneously.

item.title: Repo rate on hold at 5.25%: How your home loan changes after RBI’s policy pause
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India has kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25%, signalling a pause after a year of sharp rate cuts. For home loan borrowers, this means EMIs are likely to remain stable for now, with limited chances of either immediate relief or sudden increases.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty recover from day’s low after RBI policy outcome; ITC leads gainers
item.description: At 12:01 pm, the BSE Sensex was up 140.35 points, or 0.17%, to 83,454.28. The NSE Nifty gained 6.05 points, or 0.02%, to 25,648.85.

item.title: RBI MPC: Why was the repo rate not changed? Gov Malhotra calls decision ‘appropriate’
item.description: RBI MPC announcements: This comes even as RBI reduced policy rate by 125 basis points since February 2025. In the last policy review in December, the RBI trimmed the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.25 per cent.

item.title: How India’s IT sector is facing up to the AI threat
item.description: How India’s IT sector is facing up to the AI threat

item.title: RBI MPC: Will have new GDP, inflation series in a few days, says Gov Sanjay Malhotra
item.description: RBI MPC announcements: “Going forward, the MPC will be guided by the evolving macroeconomic conditions and the outlook based on data from the new series in charting the future course of monetary policy,” said Governor Malhotra.
